rationale: Create one manager-level active U.S. gas-storage platform for Bear River Midstream, LLC. An I Squared affiliate completed the acquisition of 100% of Belle Butte LLC from Spire Midstream on June 30, 2026 and launched Bear River to operate the Stallion and Salt Plains storage businesses. The purchase agreement identifies ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III, L.P. as the buyer fund and equity provider, while Subterra Energy Holdings, LLC and its successor Subterra Energy Borrower, LLC form the disclosed acquisition chain. Because that fund does not yet exist as a production Fund record, preserve the verified fund and vehicle names in vehicle text without inventing a fund link. Keep Belle Butte, the storage operators, their fields, interconnects, pipelines and other subsidiaries beneath the single platform. No later sale, recapitalization or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

afterImage.name: Bear River Midstream
afterImage.description: Bear River Midstream is a U.S. natural-gas-storage platform operating Stallion Gas Storage in Wyoming and Salt Plains Gas Storage in Oklahoma. Together the facilities comprise three storage fields with 72 Bcf of certificated working-gas capacity and interconnections serving utilities, pipelines, power generators, industrial users, marketers and producers. An I Squared affiliate completed the acquisition of 100% of Belle Butte LLC from Spire Midstream on June 30, 2026 and launched Bear River as the manager-level platform. The purchase agreement identifies ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III, L.P. as the buyer fund and equity provider, with Subterra Energy Holdings, LLC and successor Subterra Energy Borrower, LLC in the acquisition chain. The exact upstream equity link to Bear River Midstream, LLC and any co-investor percentages are not publicly disclosed, so no manager-level percentage is inferred. Belle Butte, Stallion, Salt Plains, their fields, interconnects, pipelines and legal subsidiaries are treated as underlying assets rather than separate PortCos. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: Spire Midstream and Subterra Energy Holdings executed the agreement for the sale of 100% of Belle Butte LLC, with ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III identified as the buyer fund and equity provider.
Subterra Energy Borrower completed the acquisition of Belle Butte and its two storage operators from Spire, and I Squared launched Bear River Midstream as the operating platform.
Salt Plains Gas Storage filed a post-closing change-in-circumstances report with FERC, confirming regulatory continuity after the acquisition.
